all_found.desc: [BUG] owner() marks repo.StoreDir/repo.Toplevel errors as unattributable, so in a bare-main repository a transient git lookup failure on a still-existing worktree puts that worktree's run in orphaned (warning only) instead of a blocker. A live worktree's abandoned run can pass the Stop hook without a blocker whenever a git lookup fails.

rejected.desc: [BUG] The orphan warning reconstructs <StoreDir>/runs/<id> as the directory to delete, but scanAbandonedRuns also scans the 0.13.x legacy location, so an orphan found there is pointed at a path that does not hold it. Deleting the named path leaves the legacy run and the warning in place.
